definitions.explanation: The angular distance east of the prime meridian, measured in degrees. Used to specify locations east of the prime meridian (Greenwich).

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}は{東経|とうけい}139{度|ど}に{位置|いち}している。
examples.english: Tokyo is located at 139 degrees east longitude.

examples.japanese: {東経|とうけい}135{度|ど}が{日本|にほん}の{標準時|ひょうじゅんじ}の{基準|きじゅん}だ。
examples.english: 135 degrees east longitude is the basis for Japan Standard Time.

examples.japanese: この{島|しま}は{東経|とうけい}150{度|ど}、{北緯|ほくい}35{度|ど}に{位置|いち}する。
examples.english: This island is located at 150 degrees east longitude and 35 degrees north latitude.

notes:
{東経|とうけい} is the opposite of {西経|せいけい} (west longitude).

FORMS:
{東|とう} (east) + {経|けい} (longitude) = east longitude

RELATED WORDS:
- {西経|せいけい}: west longitude
- {北緯|ほくい}: north latitude
- {南緯|なんい}: south latitude
- {経度|けいど}: longitude
- {緯度|いど}: latitude
- {本初|ほんしょ}{子午線|しごせん}: prime meridian

USAGE:
Typically expressed as {東経|とうけい}〜{度|ど} (〜 degrees east longitude).
